title: Apply template
purpose: Create a new storage unit with its racks, shelves and boxes (and every position) from an active template version.
summary: Create a new storage unit with its racks, shelves, boxes and every position from an active template version.

tasks.title: Create the unit
steps: Choose the [[Room]] and type the [[Unit code]] and [[Unit name]].
Select [[Apply template]]. The new unit opens.

tasks.title: Check the layout first
steps: Read the Layout outline on the template's page.

good_to_know: Everything is created in one step, or nothing is.
Class, technology and nominal temperature come from the recipe.
Codes inside the unit are its code plus each suffix in the recipe.

sections.title: Fields
paragraphs: Only the admin and manager roles can open or submit this form. Inactive templates cannot be applied; opening this page for one returns to the template with a message.
Everything is created in one step. If any part fails, nothing is created and the form shows the error.

items.label: Room
items.description: Required; active rooms, shown as site / room.

items.label: Unit code
items.description: Required. Up to 40 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit. Stored in capitals. It can never be changed or reused, even after retirement. Prefix of every generated code: rack T01 in unit VP-02 becomes VP-02-T01. A generated code over 40 characters is refused; use a shorter unit code.

sections.title: What is created
paragraphs: The unit takes its storage class, technology and nominal temperature from the recipe, and records the template version it came from. Racks, shelves and boxes are created exactly as the template describes, with all positions. The audit trail records the application.

items.label: Apply template
items.description: Creates the unit and opens it.
